note: Genuine consequential questions only. No item here is resolved by AI.

items.title: Where should the private review queue live?
items.question: The repository is public, so this file is visible to anyone. Should review items move to a private location?
items.currentBehavior: Queue is stored in the public repo; it contains no personal data or secrets, only regulatory questions.
options: Move to a private repo or issue tracker
items.recommendation: Move to a private GitHub repository or private issues if drafts could contain sensitive analysis; current contents are safe to be public.

items.title: Legacy rules have not had formal human interpretation sign-off
items.question: Approve the 47 confident rules implemented before governance (marked legacy_unreviewed), or schedule professional review?
items.currentBehavior: Rules run in production; all cite tier 0-1 official sources; none were changed in this pass.
options: Professional (zoning attorney/architect) review of critical rules first
items.recommendation: Professional review of the 21 critical rules first; the rest can be approved by the owner.

items.title: Front setback averaging (Sec. 3.1.3)
items.question: Should HPP ever calculate front setbacks from neighboring houses?
items.recommendation: Keep referral; HPP has no reliable neighbor data.

items.title: C-67 residential facade-width limit (Sec. 1.5.7)
